NAME

md_docs_2cmake-workflows - CMake workflows

Use Clang and Ninja on every platform. default keeps the usual build/ directory, and release keeps build_release/ for existing packaging scripts. Other build variants get distinct directories under build/<preset>/, except presets with explicit CI or tooling paths. The directory convention is the same on Windows, Linux and macOS. 

cmake --workflow --preset check-default
cmake --workflow --preset check-shared
cmake --workflow --preset check-static

These workflows configure, build the executable and run its --version smoke test. shared explicitly selects system libc and shared dependencies. static uses the release platform policy, including musl on supported Linux hosts. Static and shared library targets remain available independently of the executable's dependency policy.

On Criterion-supported systems, cmake --workflow --preset tests builds the test target and runs the complete suite. The unit, integration and performance test presets use the tests-enabled configuration. Windows does not support Criterion; use the executable smoke workflows there. On Intel macOS, run Criterion tests through Docker as described in AGENTS.md.

Dependency source downloads can be shared. New configurations keep legacy dependency build/install outputs inside their own binary directories. Explicit cache-directory overrides remain supported. Once configured, a build tree rejects changes to compiler, target ABI, CRT or static/shared dependency policy; select another preset or use cmake --fresh to change those settings.

Musl toolchain

USE_MUSL=ON selects cmake/toolchains/Musl.cmake before project(). It selects Clang's target triple, musl headers and CRT startup files and keeps host package searches out of the target build. Programs such as Perl and Make still run on the host. ASCIICHAT_MUSL_SYSROOT can select a complete target SDK; otherwise the toolchain discovers the distribution's packaged musl paths.

The platform module stages the matching Alpine C++ runtime and non-CMake libraries. Source dependencies use the same compiler/header settings through MuslFlags.cmake. Project C++ sources use those runtime headers as well. Use a fresh configuration when adopting the toolchain in a pre-existing musl build tree. A separate shared/glibc preset produces libraries for glibc hosts.

Installed SDK

Build static-lib and/or shared-lib, then install the Development component. Both find_package(asciichat CONFIG REQUIRED) and find_package(ascii-chat CONFIG REQUIRED) are supported. The package version tracks the library ABI (lib/v*), independently of the executable's version. For the current 0.x ABI, version compatibility is restricted to the same minor.

Use COMPONENTS shared or COMPONENTS static to require a particular variant. The targets are asciichat::shared and asciichat::static, with the existing ascii-chat::* spellings retained. asciichat::asciichat selects an available shared library first. A shared-only consumer does not resolve static link requirements. Archives built with IPO propagate Clang ThinLTO linker options (including LLD on Linux). Static consumers need pkg-config and the required development packages; missing dependencies fail during configuration. Config files and selected source-built support libraries relocate with the installed prefix.

Windows consumers can match the SDK's CRT with the target property MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=${asciichat_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY}. The installed-SDK smoke project demonstrates this without changing the consumer's global flags.

Formatting

cmake --Build System Build System --target format formats all owned C, C++, Objective-C, headers and C-family templates, including public headers and every test type. format-check checks the same inventory; clang-format and clang-format-check are aliases. Git checkouts include tracked and newly created nonignored source files while excluding submodules and generated outputs. Source archives use the authored source directories instead. The inventory is collected when the target runs and passed through a response file, so Windows command-line limits and new test files are handled consistently. Run vp format from web/ for frontend code.
